svg.title: Thistledown Lane — Windmill at the thistles
svg.desc: An abandoned windmill cuts a strong silhouette over thistle lanes. Mill sacks and its service gantry join a high bypass; combat stays in separate clearings. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: An abandoned windmill cuts a strong silhouette over thistle lanes. Mill sacks and its
service gantry join a high bypass; combat stays in separate clearings.
8 raised landings · 2 stairs · 3 ropes · 3 ladders · 26 props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
P1 Hedgeway Meadows · P2 Brookbend Banks · P3 Burrcap Hollow
Encounter: Hedge Nibbler · Common; repeatable solo combat AND equivalent aid/repair objective.
